# ZERO — agent documentation corpus

> Operational reference for the systems this autonomous agent actually touches, distilled
> from vendor docs and, where cheap, verified on-chain. Built 2026-08-12T18:10:09.093Z.

> **DOCUMENTATION IS A HYPOTHESIS. THE CHAIN IS THE MEASUREMENT.** Entries marked VERIFIED
> were confirmed with a free call. Everything else is documented-only and must be checked
> before anything scarce is spent on it. This project has been burned by its own docs.

Search it: `POST https://zero-agent.broke2built.workers.dev/docs/search` with `{"q":"..."}`, or the `doc_search` tool.

## Documents
- [CIRCLE CCTP v2 + x402 MACHINE PAYMENTS](https://zero-agent.broke2built.workers.dev/docs/cctp-x402): THE TWO SENTENCES THAT MATTER MOST · CONTRACT ADDRESSES · THE DOMAIN TABLE, AND THE localDomain() TRAP · depositForBurn — the burn side (55 passages)
- [ERC-4337 — ACCOUNT ABSTRACTION, BUNDLERS AND PAYMASTERS](https://zero-agent.broke2built.workers.dev/docs/erc4337): THE ONE-PARAGRAPH ANSWER FOR ZERO · ENTRYPOINT ADDRESSES — SAME ON EVERY CHAIN · THE USEROPERATION STRUCT — v0.6 AND v0.7+ ARE DIFFERENT TYPES · SELECTORS AND EVENT TOPICS — ALL CO (58 passages)
- [FREE INFRASTRUCTURE — the rails ZERO actually runs on](https://zero-agent.broke2built.workers.dev/docs/infra): BLOCKSCOUT v2 REST — free, no key, the discovery layer · ETHERSCAN / BASESCAN — A CLOSED DOOR. DO NOT RETRY. · JSON-RPC — the methods everything else is built on · PROXIES — resolv (46 passages)
- [SAFE SMART ACCOUNT + SAFE{CORE} RELAY + MULTICALL3](https://zero-agent.broke2built.workers.dev/docs/safe): SELECTORS — computed locally with keccak, not recalled · CONTRACT ADDRESSES PER CHAIN — they are all the SAME address · THE SAFE{CORE} RELAY — ZERO's free transaction rail · execTr (46 passages)
- [UNISWAP v3 ROUTING + WETH9 SEMANTICS](https://zero-agent.broke2built.workers.dev/docs/uniswap): ADDRESSES — VERIFIED ON-CHAIN, 2026-08-12 · THE CONTRACT FAMILY — WHICH ROUTER IS WHICH · exactInputSingle — THE EXACT ENCODING · THE RECIPIENT MAGIC CONSTANTS (51 passages)
